# Mangrove Residences

> Mangrove Residences is a three-tower residential scheme in Expo City Dubai, the district built on the legacy site of Expo 2020 and served by its own metro station. It offers about 450 one- to three-bedroom apartments, four-bedroom loft apartments and three-bedroom townhouses, set above podium gardens with sky terraces, pools and three basement parking levels. A low-carbon mesh façade shades the elevations and reduces solar gain.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Expo City Dubai, UAE
- Status: On-Going
- Year: 2026

## MENASCO Scope

Mangrove Residences is a three-tower residential development at the heart of Expo City Dubai, offering 450 one- to three-bedroom apartments, four-bedroom loft apartments and three-bedroom townhouses, with podium gardens, sky terraces and a low-carbon mesh façade. Developed by Expo City Dubai, it forms part of the city's Expo Central residential cluster. MENASCO's scope covers the MEP sub-contract works for the development.
